description: One capability across four framework versions, as a consumer would observe it from installed distribution manifests. foundation/0006 R14 fixes the vocabulary, R15 forbids skipping deprecated, and R16 makes retiring a consumed capability owe a migration and a test that fails against the old behavior. A fixture rather than a real retirement: nothing in the framework has needed to go yet, and retiring something to demonstrate retirement would be manufacturing the evidence.

releases.note: installed and exercised by a fixture
